authoredCards.body: Here you are again, at the threshold. Another year ending, another beginning waiting. If you've learned so much about what you don't want to carry forward, this New Moon in Capricorn on New Year's Eve isn't asking for resolutions that sound good to others. It's asking what foundation YOU want to build for your future self. Not the one that looks successful. The one that feels sustainable. Your legacy doesn't have to impress anyone. It just has to be true to who you're becoming.
authoredCards.intention: What foundation am I ready to build for the person I'm becoming, not the person I was supposed to be?
authoredCards.ritual: Light a brown or green candle. Reflect on the year's growth and write down one legacy intention that will guide your choices in the year ahead.
authoredCards.energy: Legacy building, sustainable achievement, disciplined wisdom, long-term vision, authentic authority, structured integrity
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: If you've been playing by rules that were never yours, following paths that made sense to everyone except you, this New Moon in Aquarius is your permission slip to stop fitting in where you were never meant to belong. If you've spent so long making yourself smaller to be understood, editing your truth to be palatable, it's time to stop. What if your weirdness is exactly what the world needs? What if the thing that makes you different is the thing that makes you valuable? Stop apologizing for seeing things differently. Your revolution doesn't need anyone's approval.
authoredCards.intention: What truth have I been hiding because I thought it was too much, too different, too revolutionary?
authoredCards.ritual: Do something completely different from your usual routine. Light a blue or silver candle and write down one way you want to rebel against expectations and lead with your unique vision.
authoredCards.energy: Innovation, independence, humanitarian vision, authentic rebellion, collective service
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: If you've been holding it all together for so long that you've forgotten what it feels like to let go, to trust, to stop managing every outcome, this New Moon in Pisces is asking you to loosen your grip on the steering wheel. You don't have to have all the answers. You don't have to know exactly where you're going. Sometimes the bravest thing you can do is admit you're lost and let yourself be guided. Your intuition has been trying to tell you something, but you've been too busy being strong to listen. It's okay to not know. It's okay to feel your way forward.
authoredCards.intention: What am I desperately trying to control that's actually asking me to surrender?
authoredCards.ritual: Take a bath or shower with sea salt. Let the water wash away what no longer serves. Set intentions through feeling, not thinking.
authoredCards.energy: Intuition, surrender, compassion, creativity, spiritual flow, unconditional love
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: This eclipse doesn't care about your five-year plan. It's not interested in what makes sense or what's practical. It wants to know what makes you feel ALIVE. If you've been waiting for permission, for the right time, for things to feel less scary, this eclipse is showing you that the only permission you need is your own. If you've spent years being who you needed to be to survive, this is about who you want to become. Stop waiting to be ready. You were born ready. The fear you feel? That's not a warning. It's confirmation that this matters.
authoredCards.intention: What would I start immediately if I stopped waiting for permission?
authoredCards.ritual: Do something that scares you but excites you equally. Light a red candle and write down one thing you're going to start immediately.
authoredCards.energy: Courage, initiation, leadership, pioneering spirit, authentic action, fearless beginning
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: If you've been undervaluing yourself for so long that it feels normal, accepting less because you didn't want to seem difficult, giving discounts on your worth because someone made you feel like you were asking for too much, this New Moon in Taurus is here to remind you that your worth isn't negotiable. It's not up for debate. You don't have to earn it through endless giving or prove it through exhaustion. Your value exists whether anyone sees it or not. Stop apologizing for having standards. Stop shrinking to make others comfortable with your abundance.
authoredCards.intention: What would I build if I actually believed I was worth it?
authoredCards.ritual: Plant something in soil: seeds, a plant, or even place your hands on the earth. Set an intention for what you want to grow slowly and sustainably in terms of worth and value.
authoredCards.energy: Self-worth, stability, patience, sensuality, building value, embodied wisdom
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: If you've been telling the same stories about yourself for years, the ones that keep you small, safe, understood, what if those stories were never true? This New Moon in Gemini is asking you to examine the narrative you've been living in. The one where you're always fine, always handling it, never needing too much. If you've edited yourself for so long that you don't remember your real voice, it's time to find it again. Stop explaining yourself to people who are committed to misunderstanding you. Your truth doesn't need to make everyone comfortable.
authoredCards.intention: What story about myself am I ready to stop telling, and what truth am I ready to speak instead?
authoredCards.ritual: Write down three stories you tell yourself that limit you. Burn them and write three new, empowering stories to replace them. Focus on authentic communication.
authoredCards.energy: Communication, curiosity, learning, adaptability, authentic expression, mental flexibility
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: If you've been everyone's safe space while having nowhere to land yourself, the strong one, the caretaker, the one who holds it all together, this New Moon in Cancer is asking what it would look like to create safety for yourself. Not the kind where you manage everyone's emotions so there's no conflict. Real safety. Where you can fall apart without apologizing. Where you can need without feeling guilty. If you've been so busy nurturing everyone else that you forgot you deserve care too, this is your reminder. Your needs aren't an inconvenience. They're valid.
authoredCards.intention: What kind of emotional safety have I been giving everyone else that I need to give myself?
authoredCards.ritual: Create a sanctuary space in your home. Light a white candle and set an intention for how you want to nurture yourself and create emotional safety.
authoredCards.energy: Emotional safety, nurturing, intuition, home, family, protective care, deep feeling
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: If you've been dimming your light to make others feel more comfortable with their darkness, playing small so no one feels threatened, hiding your joy because someone once made you feel like it was too much, this New Moon in Leo wants you to stop apologizing for shining. Your brightness isn't arrogance; it's authenticity. You don't need permission to take up space, to be seen, to celebrate yourself. The world doesn't need another person pretending to be less than they are. It needs you, fully expressed, unapologetically radiant.
authoredCards.intention: What part of myself have I been hiding because I thought it was "too much"?
authoredCards.ritual: Stand in front of a mirror and appreciate your unique gifts without needing anyone else's validation. Crown yourself with your own approval.
authoredCards.energy: Authentic confidence, creative expression, heart-centered leadership, joy, generous spirit, natural radiance
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: If you've been using perfectionism as armor, thinking if you could just get it right, be good enough, organized enough, disciplined enough, then you'd finally feel worthy, this New Moon in Virgo is calling you out. Your worth doesn't come from your productivity. Your value isn't measured in how perfectly you can perform wellness. This is about creating routines that actually nourish you, not ones that look good on social media. Stop punishing yourself with self-improvement. Start caring for yourself with compassion.
authoredCards.intention: What would my daily life look like if it was built from self-love instead of self-improvement?
authoredCards.ritual: Organize one area of your life with love rather than judgment. Clean your space as an act of self-care, not punishment.
authoredCards.energy: Sacred routine, body wisdom, practical service, healthy discernment, devotional practice, functional beauty
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: If you've been keeping the peace by silencing your needs, being the understanding one, the flexible one, the one who never asks for too much, this New Moon in Libra is showing you that real harmony includes your voice. Real balance honors your needs too. If you've been so focused on being easy to love that you forgot to ask if these relationships are actually loving YOU, it's time to reassess. Stop negotiating your worth. Stop accepting crumbs and calling it compromise. You deserve partnerships that meet you where you are.
authoredCards.intention: What truth have I been swallowing to keep the peace, and what boundary needs to be spoken?
authoredCards.ritual: Light a pink or green candle. Write down one relationship pattern you want to transform and one way you want to show up more authentically in partnerships.
authoredCards.energy: Authentic relating, diplomatic truth, balanced partnerships, graceful boundaries, cooperative fairness
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: If you've been giving your power away in tiny pieces, through people-pleasing, through silence, through pretending things don't hurt when they do, this New Moon in Scorpio is here for your resurrection. For the part of you that's been buried under "I'm fine" and "It's okay." If you've been so afraid of your own intensity that you've been living at half-strength, hear this: your depth isn't too much; it's your superpower. Your intensity isn't wrong; it's your truth. Stop apologizing for feeling deeply. Start reclaiming what you've given away.
authoredCards.intention: What power have I been giving away that I'm ready to take back?
authoredCards.ritual: Light a black or deep red candle. Write down what you're ready to release and transform. Burn it safely, declaring your intention to reclaim your power.
authoredCards.energy: Transformation, authentic power, emotional alchemy, intimate truth, regeneration, fearless depth
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: If you've been playing small because big dreams felt dangerous, because hoping felt like setting yourself up for disappointment, this New Moon in Sagittarius wants you to remember what it feels like to believe in possibility again. If you've been so focused on what's realistic that you forgot what's magical, it's time to expand. Your vision isn't too big; your container has been too small. Stop downsizing your dreams to fit your fears. The world needs your wild hope, your impossible vision, your refusal to think small.
authoredCards.intention: What dream have I been afraid to admit I still want?
authoredCards.ritual: Light a purple or blue candle. Write down one belief that's calling you forward and one way you want to expand your impact in the world.
authoredCards.energy: Visionary expansion, adventurous truth, philosophical wisdom, global perspective, inspired teaching, meaningful exploration
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: This eclipse at the critical 29th degree is done with your perfectionism. Done with the part of you that thinks you have to earn rest. That believes you're only valuable when you're useful. If you've been running on empty, calling it discipline, burning out and calling it dedication, this eclipse is here to dismantle the systems you built from fear. The ones that keep you busy but not fulfilled, productive but not peaceful. It's time to stop mistaking exhaustion for virtue. What systems, habits, or beliefs rooted in fear-based precision are you ready to release? This eclipse refines your approach, asking you to build systems that serve your soul rather than your ego. Perfect the process, not the outcome.
authoredCards.intention: What practice or system would transform my life if I did it from love instead of fear?
authoredCards.ritual: Clean and organize something important with complete presence and love. Let this be an act of devotion to your highest self.
authoredCards.energy: Sacred refinement, releasing perfectionism, functional devotion, spiritual service through practical action
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored New Moon per-sign section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted to house punctuation; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-newmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: The Capricorn ambitions of this season are meeting Cancer's emotional wisdom, and something's got to give. If you've been building and climbing and achieving, but your soul is asking "for what? for who?" this Full Moon illuminates where success has been chosen over softness, achievement over actual nourishment. You can't keep pushing yourself this hard and calling it self-care. Your emotional needs aren't weakness. They're wisdom. It's time to stop building empires on empty hearts.
authoredCards.axis: How can I build success that actually feeds my soul instead of depleting it? This axis teaches that true achievement includes emotional well-being, family, and home. Your professional structure must support your emotional sanctuary.
authoredCards.ritual: Create a sacred space at home. Light a white candle and hold something that represents security to you. Ask how your legacy goal can create harmony between ambition and emotional nourishment.
authoredCards.completion: How does my legacy goal serve both my success and my soul?
authoredCards.notes: Owner-authored Full Moon axis-integration section (chat 2026-07-21). Em dashes converted; otherwise verbatim. Renders before the sky-fullmoon-sign fallback.

authoredCards.body: The Aquarius revolutionary energy of this season meets Leo's demand for authentic self-expression, and suddenly it's clear: you can't create authentic change while performing confidence. This Full Moon is showing where there's been leading from ego instead of truth. Where applause has been sought instead of impact. Real leadership doesn't need everyone's approval. authoredCards.body: Logic has left the building and that might be exactly what you need. The Pisces Moon dissolves the boundaries between what you think and what you feel, what's real and what's possible. You're processing things you don't have words for yet. Good for creative projects, meditation, healing work; anything that doesn't require explanation. Energy feels low because you're downloading something bigger than your mind can hold. You're allowed to not make sense right now.

authoredCards.body: Your sensitivity might be showing you things others can't see yet. The Pisces Moon dissolves your defenses, which feels vulnerable but might be necessary. You're absorbing more than you realize; emotions that aren't yours, problems you didn't create, pain that predates you. Good for artistic projects, meditation, healing work; anything that honors the mystery. You're allowed to be overwhelmed by what you're processing.

authoredCards.body: Everything feels blurry because everything is shifting. The Pisces Moon doesn't give you solid ground; it gives you the ability to swim. Your intuition is louder than logic right now, but you keep trying to make it make sense. Good for artistic projects, meditation, healing work; anything that honors the in-between space. Energy feels low because you're between chapters. You're allowed to not know what's next.

authoredCards.body: The need to be seen might be battling with the fear of being judged. Leo Moon asks you to shine, but authentically, not performatively. Your creativity wants expression, but it needs to come from joy, not from proving your worth. Good for presentations, creative projects, celebrations; if you can stop asking if you deserve the spotlight. The applause feels empty when you're performing someone else's script. You're allowed to be magnificent without apology.

authoredCards.body: A Leo Moon week wants you to take up space, but you might be exhausted from performing confidence you don't feel. The spotlight feels harsh when you're not ready for it. Creative expression flows when it's honest, stalls when it's forced. Good for presentations, creative projects, leadership; if you can lead from your actual self, not your Instagram self. You're allowed to shine without being "on."

authoredCards.body: The surface feels fake and you're too tired to pretend otherwise. Scorpio Moon doesn't let you hide from what's rotting underneath the pleasant façade. Emotional intensity demands attention; the jealousy you won't admit, the rage you keep swallowing, the desire you call dangerous. Good for therapy, research, deep conversations; anything that goes below surface. The transformation wants to happen. Stop holding it back. You're allowed to let things die.

authoredCards.body: Everything feels intense because everything IS intense. The Scorpio Moon doesn't let you numb out or check out. The emotions you've been managing are demanding to be felt. Power dynamics you've been ignoring are impossible to unsee. Good for therapy, research, intimacy; anything that requires you to stop pretending. The heaviness isn't punishment. It's truth. You're allowed to acknowledge how hard it's actually been.

authoredCards.headline: Your career changes before the explanation is ready.
authoredCards.body: A role, contract, or professional direction can change so quickly that other people assume you had the replacement lined up. You know how much improvising it took to keep your work moving once the original plan became impossible. You are allowed to call this a transition while you share what you know, acknowledge what remains undecided, and test the next direction.

authoredCards.body: You may still meet every deadline while lunch gets later, sleep gets shorter, and your patience is gone by the last call. Because the work keeps arriving, people may not realize how close you are to your limit. Change the workload while you still have a say in what gets moved.

authoredCards.body: A promotion or leadership change may bring you into conversations about budgets, staffing, and decisions that affect other people's livelihoods. authoredCards.headline: The offer may cost more than it pays.

authoredCards.headline: Your career may change before you have a clean explanation.
authoredCards.body: A field or way of working that once seemed unrealistic may suddenly make more sense than the path you were following. People who know your résumé may need time to understand the change. Start doing the work, and let the explanation come from what you learn after you begin.

authoredCards.headline: The job looked better from the outside.
authoredCards.body: A role may give you the title you wanted and leave you dreading work you once imagined enjoying. Wait before turning one difficult month into a resignation letter. Notice whether any part of the work still feels worth doing once the pressure drops.

authoredCards.headline: The opportunity may be bigger than the support around it.
authoredCards.body: An offer or public success can move you into work you have never handled at this scale. The excitement may make it easy to agree before anyone explains what comes with the role. authoredCards.headline: The decision is back on the table.

authoredCards.headline: You notice what no one says directly.
authoredCards.body: You may catch the missing number in a proposal, the hesitation behind an agreement, or the question everyone keeps avoiding. This can make you a sharp researcher or negotiator, especially when a plan depends on information no one wants to volunteer. Know what answer you need before you start digging, or you may spend the afternoon proving what you already suspected.

authoredCards.headline: The opportunity needs a plan your life can support.

The opportunity may need more time, money, or help than you currently have available. Test the idea on a smaller scale before you reorganize your life around it.

authoredCards.headline: You know how to finish difficult work.
authoredCards.body: Once the goal is clear, you can keep going through the slow part that makes other people lose interest. Other people may call your exit sudden because they did not see how long you spent following rules that made the work slower or worse. authoredCards.body: You may know exactly how a project should feel and struggle to explain what another person needs to make. Translate the idea into a draft, example, or list of decisions before assigning the work. Inspiration becomes easier to collaborate with once someone else can see what you mean.

authoredCards.headline: The work you built slowly has room to grow.

Look at the current pay, scope, and working conditions before treating familiarity as proof that the opportunity still fits. The return can show you how much your standards have changed.

authoredCards.headline: The idea is growing faster than the plan.
authoredCards.body: One exciting conversation can turn into six commitments before anyone checks the calendar. Write down what was agreed, then calculate the time, staff, and follow-up it requires. Enthusiasm is useful. Undocumented enthusiasm becomes unpaid work.

Keep records and take time before replying to a message designed to force a quick answer. You do not have to negotiate at the speed that benefits the other person.

Clients and colleagues learn that you will remember the details and return when you said you would. Familiarity can keep you in an underpaid arrangement, so put regular rate reviews on the calendar.

authoredCards.body: A vague project can absorb an entire day because the goal changes every time you get close. Before you begin, define what finished means and who has authority to approve it. A moving target will use every hour you give it.

authoredCards.headline: Your previous work opens a larger door.

Find out what support comes with the opportunity and where it can take you. Your past results give you evidence for requesting better terms, funding, mentorship, or responsibility.

authoredCards.headline: Your work is visible today.

authoredCards.headline: The demand in front of you changes the day you planned.

authoredCards.headline: Your mood and the deadline are competing.

authoredCards.headline: The right words arrive when you need them.

authoredCards.headline: A private conversation changes the public plan.
authoredCards.body: News from home or an important private discussion may affect your schedule, application, or willingness to accept an opportunity. Decide what you can realistically commit to before updating the people who depend on your answer. The public plan may need to wait until the private decision is clear.

authoredCards.headline: Support arrives through someone who knows your work.

authoredCards.headline: The opportunity has to fit your actual life.
authoredCards.body: A job or academic program may look attractive and require a move, schedule, or financial arrangement that changes everyday life. Before agreeing, picture an ordinary Tuesday: where you will live, how you will eat, how long the commute takes, and who you can call. The opportunity has to fit inside that day.

authoredCards.headline: You have enough momentum to make the next move.

authoredCards.headline: Work pressure is entering your private life.
authoredCards.body: A deadline, conflict, or competitive environment may follow you home and keep the day running long after work or class ends. Close the laptop at a specific time and write down what remains. Repeated spillover is information about the structure and deserves to be taken seriously.

authoredCards.headline: One useful introduction widens the path.
authoredCards.body: Someone with experience or influence may recognize your ability and point you toward an opportunity beyond your current options. authoredCards.headline: A larger future requires more from your life at home.
authoredCards.body: An acceptance, promotion, or distant opportunity may expand your options while requiring travel, relocation, or a more demanding schedule. Calculate the housing, transportation, care, and time involved before excitement makes the decision for you. Growth still has to work on an ordinary week.

authoredCards.headline: The next step comes with real responsibility.

Get clear on the timeline, evaluation process, and support before committing to the workload. The title or qualification will matter more when the structure around it is workable.

authoredCards.headline: A practical change makes the work easier.

authoredCards.headline: Your imagination finds a place in the work.

authoredCards.headline: You can negotiate from a stronger position.

authoredCards.body: Transiting Chiron conjunct your natal Chiron sits directly on your sore spot for a long pass, turning it all the way up as an older tenderness in you recognizes this one for what it is. It surfaces as an unexpected wave of feeling about something you thought you'd already dealt with. This transit shows you exactly how much of the old story you've outgrown and how much is still raw underneath the competence. You don't have to have healed it completely by now. Sit with what's still tender, and the recognition itself does some of the work.
authoredCards.note: Phase 1 exact transit-aspect unit, imported verbatim.

authoredCards.body: Chiron sits directly on your North Node for a long pass, and the growth direction runs straight through the sore spot you'd rather avoid. Old insecurities surface where the newer life asks you to show up: the fear of being unqualified right as the opening requires you to apply anyway, the fear of being too much right as the direction needs your full volume. It exposes how much the sore spot has been steering you away from what it's trying to teach you. Walk toward the direction with the sore spot still tender, and it becomes the teacher.
authoredCards.note: Phase 1 exact transit-aspect unit, imported verbatim.

authoredCards.body: Chiron sits right on your south node for a long pass, and the coping habit built around an old sore spot moves front and center: the joke before anyone else can make it, the apology before you've done anything wrong, making yourself smaller so the sore spot never gets touched. It surfaces around the situations that taught you the habit in the first place. This transit exposes how much energy the habit still takes to maintain. You don't have to retire the coping habit today. Just notice it running, and ask if the sore spot still needs that much protecting.
authoredCards.note: Phase 1 exact transit-aspect unit, imported verbatim.

authoredCards.body: Transiting Chiron opposition your natal Chiron puts someone else's raw edge directly across from your own sore spot for a long pass. It shows up when a person close to you is processing something that mirrors your own old insecurity, and watching them stumble through it stirs up more than you expect. An older tenderness in you recognizes this one in them. You don't have to fix their process to manage your own. Let their struggle remind you of your progress instead of your exposure, and the mirror stops feeling like a threat.
authoredCards.note: Phase 1 exact transit-aspect unit, imported verbatim.

authoredCards.body: Chiron opposes your North Node for a long pass, pulling you back toward the coping habits that protect the sore spot just as the newer direction asks you to expose it a little. You retreat to the identity that never gets tested, the role where the old insecurity stays quietly hidden, right when growth asks you to risk it being seen. It exposes how much the retreat has cost you in the life you actually want. You don't have to expose the sore spot to everyone. Let the newer direction see it anyway, and the insecurity loses its grip.
authoredCards.note: Phase 1 exact transit-aspect unit, imported verbatim.
